release_notes: Eight palette themes join Personalization: four color schemes, each in a light and a dark variant — Cobalt (signal blue on white or pure black), Canary (black CTAs on white; canary yellow on charcoal), Parchment (warm cream canvas with ink CTAs; ink canvas with cream surfaces in dark), and Indigo (violet-blue on a light canvas or deep indigo). The palettes are ported from published brand design analyses under neutral color names — no brand names, marks, or fonts ship with them. Leftover hardcoded grays in Automation, Admin Status and the campaign Tracking tab were replaced with theme variables so every theme paints those pages correctly, and the Tracking tab got more compact (options panel only for methods that have options, full-width generated-code block). Also fixed: a doubled '+ +' on the Add Cost Connection button. This release repairs the frontend bundle shipped in 1.1.2 as well: the Conversion Types page had been committed in a state that could not compile, so the unmapped-statuses section advertised in the 1.1.2 notes never actually reached users — the JSX is fixed and the UI ships for real this time. No manual server steps are required.
